name: build-profiles help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:build-profiles. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Seed the plan
entries.text: A new profile's plan starts from the framework's seed and feature catalog instead of empty.

entries.title: Take off the list
entries.text: Removes the profile from the list. Its data stays on disk.

entries.title: Copy of
entries.text: Starts the new profile as a copy of another one.

entries.title: Use it right away
entries.text: Switches to the new profile as soon as it's made.

entries.title: Clean up builds
entries.text: Lists archived builds that really finished, and builds in a profile that no longer exists. One tap fixes each.

entries.title: Clean up builds
entries.text: Opens the cleanup list: archived builds that really finished, with a one-tap fix.

entries.title: Review cleanup
entries.text: Opens the list of builds the cleanup scan flagged, so you can fix them.

entries.title: Fix
entries.text: Gives this build the status it earned (complete or landed), or moves it to the base profile. Nothing is deleted.

entries.title: Fix all
entries.text: Fixes every build on the list that can be fixed. Builds marked "needs a look" are left alone.

entries.title: Scan again
entries.text: Checks the builds again. Changes nothing.

entries.title: Build profiles
entries.text: Every build profile in one grid: its builds, what it cost and when it last moved. Open a row to see what is in it and to change it.

entries.title: Build profile
entries.text: One profile: its details, its numbers, what is in it and every action you can take on it.

entries.title: New, edit or duplicate
entries.text: The form for a profile: its name, description, colour and icon. A new one starts empty or as a copy.

entries.title: Merge build profiles
entries.text: Moves every build of one profile into another. The first profile comes off the list unless you keep it.

entries.title: Move builds
entries.text: Sends the builds you name to another profile. Each keeps its id, status and steps.

entries.title: Confirm the change
entries.text: Says what archiving, taking off the list, restoring or deleting data will do before you press the button.

entries.title: Manage profiles
entries.text: Opens the Build profiles page with every profile in a grid.

entries.title: Switch profile
entries.text: Opens the quick picker to change the profile the console works on.

entries.title: Duplicate
entries.text: Makes a second profile with copies of this one's files. Its builds show in both.

entries.title: Merge into
entries.text: Moves every build of this profile into another one you pick.

entries.title: Profile row
entries.text: Tap the row to open or close what is in this profile: builds, pending, queue, plan and files.

entries.title: Start with
entries.text: Starts the new profile empty, or as a copy of another one.

entries.title: Show its builds in the copy
entries.text: On: the copy lists the same builds. Off: it starts with the files and no builds.

entries.title: Delete data
entries.text: Opens the confirm for deleting this profile's data for good. Owner only.

entries.title: Delete its data
entries.text: Deletes the profile's files and the builds that live only in it. It can't be undone.
